channel.title: Wire — JavaScript
channel.description: JavaScript from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: How Sindre Sorhus' Personal Site is Now Made in Swift
item.description: SwiftUI-like components, styles as modifiers, and a compiler that catches broken links before visitors do. How this site is made, and why I love working on it. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: free trial and demo!
item.description: STRICH is a JavaScript SDK for real-time, 1D/2D barcode scanning in web apps. STRICH is fast, reliable and has competitive, transparent pricing. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports AWS Lambda Web Functions as an origin
item.description: Starting today, you can deliver web applications built on AWS Lambda Web Functions through CloudFront's global edge network. (2 sources: aws, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
item.description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places. (6 sources: cloudflare, hackernews, javascriptweekly, lobsters, reactstatus, rprogramming)

item.title: Expo is mobile AI infrastructure
item.description: Expo is the fastest way to build native apps for iOS, Android, and the web with React. (3 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: six months of building with v3
item.description: Six months on Remix v3 turned into 88 packages, because I kept copying the framework's own design decisions. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: A Visual Notation for React's Parent and Owner Trees
item.description: Introducing a visual notation for showing React components as diagrams, for more structural overviews that code alone can't show. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: Coinbase says it's moving its app off React Native
2026 Stack Overflow Developer Survey results
item.description: More than 30K technologists from 169 countries have shared their thoughts with us, and now it’s time to share everything we’ve learned with you. So let’s dive into this year’s Annual Developer Survey. (3 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly, nodeweekly)

item.title: How to Test an iframe's postMessage Handler
item.description: There are some real complexities using iframes and the postMessage API for communication between a widget and its parent. Security vulnerabilities like cross-origin scripting risks being one. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Cloudflares Newly Acquired Vite+ Reaches 1.0 with GitLab CI Support, Hooks, and tsup Migration
item.description: VoidZero has launched Vite+ 1.0, the first stable version of its JavaScript toolchain. It features a command line tool for managing Node.js, package management, and frontend development from a single configuration file. (1 source: infoq)
